method_notes: TableII interface uses full1105920B load and4608B vector.

Legacy offset encoding is a restricted comparison and is not eligible for generic signed-INT8 mapping.

limitations: Nominal10bit deterministic diagnostics remove the large common offset of the legacy encoding;they do not certify physical analog accuracy.
